description: This file provides extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure Dependency Injection services for the ASP.NET Core application. These methods include setting up MediatR, validators, AutoMapper, authentication with JWT, and logging with Serilog. It centralizes service registration and configuration for the application's core infrastructure.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Configures core application services such as MediatR, validators, AutoMapper, password hashing, JWT token generation, and user context access.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Sets up JWT authentication, including token validation parameters, signing credentials, and message received event handling for extracting the token from headers.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Configures Serilog logging with console sink, sets log level, and attaches it to the logger factory.
